app.title: Charge Nurse
bed.clean.d: Get this bed ready for the next patient.
board.boarding: Waiting in a bay for a ward bed
board.forecast_calm: Today looks calm. A good day to upgrade.
board.surge.d: One extra nurse and doctor for today.
board.ward: {busy}/{n} busy · {dirty} to clean · {soon} going home soon
build.bay.d: {n} bays now. More patients seen at once.
clue.0.0: Twisted an ankle. Walks in slowly, but can stand on it.
clue.0.1: A small cut on the hand. Already wrapped, feels fine.
clue.0.2: A sore throat for two days. Talking and joking.
clue.1.0: A high fever since last night. Tired, but talking clearly.
clue.1.1: Fell off a bike. The wrist is swollen and hurts.
clue.1.2: Stomach pain for a few hours. Can sit and wait.
clue.2.0: Short of breath when walking. Needs to sit down.
clue.2.1: A bad fall from a ladder. Cannot put weight on the leg.
clue.2.2: Chest feels tight. Pale and worried.
clue.3.0: Very hard to breathe. Can only say a few words.
clue.3.1: Fainted and is still very drowsy.
clue.3.2: Strong chest pain that does not stop. Needs help now.
coach.1: Hi, nurse! A patient is waiting. Tap the patient.
coach.10: The shift is ending. Tap Hand over.
coach.2: Choose a colour. This one is green: mild. Tap Green.
coach.2.wrong: Read the card again: an ankle that can still walk is mild. Try Green.
coach.3: Send them to a room. Tap the free bay.
coach.4: Great. The doctor treats them. When it's done, tap Discharge.
coach.5: Now the bed is dirty. Tap it to clean it.
coach.6: An ambulance! Red goes first. Tap Accept.
coach.7: This patient needs a scan. Open the X-ray room.
coach.8: More patients are coming. Hire a second porter.
coach.9: Something is blocking the flow. Tap the red line.
crisis.flu_surge.b: Many more patients arrive. Call the surge team.
crisis.inspection.b: Keep beds clean and waits short until the shift change.
crisis.norovirus.b: Some beds are closed for cleaning for two days.
crisis.power_outage.b: Scans and surgery pause until the power is back.
crisis.power_saved.b: The backup generator kept everything running.
crisis.scanner_down.b: One scan room is out of order for a while.
crisis.supply_delay.b: Supplies cost more for two days.
err.too_late: A doctor already saw this patient.
graphics.dropped: Graphics lowered to keep the game smooth. You can change it in Settings.
hud.speed_locked: Faster speeds come with the Speed Pack.
iap.bundle.d: Ad-free, the Edition, the Speed Pack and all three themes.
iap.cash_l.d: Five days of your usual income.
iap.cash_m.d: Two and a half days of your usual income.
iap.cash_s.d: One day of your usual income.
iap.cash_xl.d: Ten days of your usual income.
iap.noads.d: No more ads between shifts. Rewards come without a video.
iap.premium.d: Ad-free, gold hospital theme and one day of starter supplies.
iap.speed.d: Play at 3× and 4× speed. Skip the shift report automatically.
iap.starter.d: Two days of income and one extra porter. Does not remove ads.
iap.theme_modern.d: Cool glass and steel look for your hospital.
iap.theme_pediatric.d: Bright pastel colours for a friendly hospital.
intro.1.b: You are the charge nurse. Patients arrive all day. You keep them moving.
intro.2.b: Give each patient a colour. Red goes first, green can wait.
intro.3.b: The real problem is often a bed nobody cleaned. Find it and fix it.
lens.bays: All bays are busy. Add a bay or treat patients faster.
lens.beds: Admitted patients wait in the bays for a ward bed. New patients cannot get in. Add ward beds or speed up discharges.
lens.dirty: Beds are empty but dirty. The cleaners are behind. Tap a bed to clean it or hire cleaners.
lens.discharge: Patients are ready to go home, but nobody signed them out. Their beds stay blocked. Tap Discharge or hire nurses.
lens.doctors: Patients wait in bays for a doctor. Hire doctors.
lens.or: Patients wait for the operating room. Each surgery takes time and a doctor.
lens.porters: A bed is free, but no porter can move the patient. Hire porters.
lens.reception: People wait at the front desk. Hire receptionists.
lens.smooth: Everything is moving. Nothing is blocking the corridors right now.
lens.tests: The scan room has a queue. Hire a technician for it.
lens.triage: People wait for a colour. Tag them yourself or hire nurses.
offline.title: While you were away
patient.board: Admitted — waiting for a bed on {ward}
patient.discharge.d: Sign them out now. The bed is free sooner.
patient.note_lost: The handover note was lost — this takes longer.
patient.tag_help: Read the card. Red is the most urgent, green the mildest.
patient.title: Patient #{n}
report.calm: Calm handover: the teams are rested.
report.rushed: Rushed handover: notes lost, teams still tired.
report.title: Day {n} report
research.discharge_lounge.d: Ready patients wait in the lounge. Ward beds free up at once.
research.diversion_rules.d: Send unanswered ambulances away when the ED is too full.
research.fast_track.d: Free nurses treat mild green cases without a bay.
research.generator.d: Power cuts no longer stop the scans and the OR.
research.help: Upgrades work during the shift. One at a time.
research.night_team.d: More staff on the night shift.
research.porter_tablets.d: Porters get jobs on a tablet and move faster.
research.quiet_hours.d: Teams get tired more slowly. Less burnout.
research.surge_stock.d: Flu weeks and supply delays hit softer.
research.triage_training.d: Nurses pick the right colour more often.
research.waiting_hall.d: People wait longer before they give up.
reward.call_neighbor.b: They take {n} waiting patients. Once per crisis.
reward.daily_bonus.b: A little money to start the day.
reward.done_float: A float helper joined {team} for an hour.
reward.done_neighbor: {n} patients went to the neighbour hospital.
reward.float_nurse.b: One extra helper joins {team} for an hour.
reward.free.b: Included with your ad-free pack — no video.
reward.offline_x2.b: Watch a short video to get it twice.
room.ct.d: Fast detailed scans for serious cases. Comes with one technician.
room.lab.d: Quick sample tests. Comes with one technician.
room.or.d: Surgery for serious cases. Needs a doctor and an ICU or surgical bed after.
room.xray.d: Scans for broken bones and chests. Comes with one technician.
rule.divert.locked: Unlock the Diversion Rules upgrade to send ambulances away by themselves.
rule.queue.help: Red always goes first. Choose the order for everyone else.
settings.guide: How to play / Replay the guide
settings.title: Settings
shop.cap: Daily pack limit reached. Come back tomorrow.
shop.restore_failed: Could not restore. Try again later.
shop.title: Shop
shop.unavailable: The store is not available right now
staff.burnout_high: The teams are burning out: everyone works slower and more call in sick. Hire help and keep shifts calm.
stage.move: On the way with a porter
team.cleaner.d: Clean beds and bays between patients.
team.clerk.d: Sign new patients in at the front desk.
team.doctor.d: Treat patients in the bays and in surgery.
team.nurse.d: Give colours, sign discharges, fast-track mild cases.
team.porter.d: Move admitted patients to the wards.
team.tech.d: Each scan room needs its own technicians. More = faster scans.
tip.ambulance: An ambulance is calling! Accept for a bonus, or divert if you are full.
tip.board: This patient needs a ward bed. Check the Board: are beds full or dirty?
tip.city: City General is open: surgery, intensive care and a CT scanner.
tip.crash: A crash brings many patients. Keep bays moving, discharge fast.
tip.ct: The CT scanner is open for serious cases.
tip.diversion: Set the diversion rule on the Board.
tip.fast_track: Fast track: idle nurses now treat green cards.
tip.inspection: Inspection today: clean beds and short waits earn a bonus.
tip.lab: The lab is open. Give it technicians in the Staff tab.
tip.lounge: Discharge lounge: ready patients leave their beds right away.
tip.lwbs: Someone left without being seen. Long waits cost reputation.
tip.norovirus: Some ward beds are closed. Watch the Board for boarding patients.
tip.or: The operating room is open. After surgery, red patients need an ICU bed.
tip.power: Power cut: scans wait. The generator upgrade prevents this.
tip.report: This is your shift report. Stars for care, waits and flow raise your reputation.
tip.rushed: No handover today: notes were lost and the teams stay tired. Tap Hand over at 18:30.
tip.scanner: A scanner is down. Patients wait for that scan.
tip.sick: Someone called in sick. Burnout makes this more likely.
tip.supply: Supplies cost more for a while.
tip.surge: Flu week! Call the surge team on the Board.
tip.town: The Town Hospital is open: more patients, a general ward and a lab.
tip.transfer: A patient was moved to another hospital. Keep a bay free for red cards.
tip.worsened: Someone waited too long and got worse. Red and orange cards cannot wait long.
toast.amb_accept: Ambulance accepted. The crew brings the patient straight in.
toast.amb_divert: Ambulance sent to another hospital. The region notices.
toast.discharged: Discharged — the bed is free for the next patient.
toast.inspection_bad: Inspection found dirty beds or long waits. Fine {cash}.
wing.city.d: Operating room, intensive care, surgical ward, CT and lifts.
wing.clinic.d: Your first clinic: one corridor, a few bays.
wing.town.d: A bigger ED, a general ward, a lab and a discharge lounge.
